collected.notes:
I checked these sources on 2026-10-12: the Anthropic launch page (headline table plus the chart aria-labels for each effort level), the Opus 5.5 system card (230 pages, text extracted and the figure pages viewed as images), and the Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 system cards.

Four columns have no comparable vendor or third-party score: SciCode, CritPt, GDP.pdf and AA-LCR. Anthropic does not report them, and Artificial Analysis numbers are already in the dataset.

Benchmark-author leaderboards:
- tbench.ai TB4: 64.85 (max, Claude Code).
- frontierswe.com: 62.3.
- Zapier: 42.47 (Max) and 35.77 (XHigh), both with default fallbacks.
- Snorkel ALE: Score 63.2 / Pass 38.2.
- Not listed on DeepSWE (Datacurve, snapshot updated 2026-09-22), the Toolathlon homepage preview, the Scale HLE boards or the osworld-v2 site.
- The tbench Terminal-Bench-Science board and agents-last-exam.org render client-side, so I could not read them.

OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol launch page returns 403 to both curl and WebFetch, so none of the Opus 5.5 numbers the leads attribute to it are verified: GDP.pdf 25.6–28.8, TB-Science 63.3, and the AutomationBench sweep. The leads' source is an alphacorp.ai repost, and the secondary blogs disagree with each other. One OpenAI forum chart does plot "Opus 5.5 w/ fallbacks" on AutomationBench, but it has no data labels, so I did not record it.

Anthropic's own numbers that repeat on the Sonnet/Haiku launch pages and cards are not recorded again.

Caveats:
- OSWorld: the launch page says 2.1 while the system card says 2.0 (task files dated Sept 10, 2026).
- TB4: the headline is at xhigh; max is 64.8.
- FrontierCode: the best Main score is at medium (54.6); the max-effort score is 54.4.
- GDPval-AA: Elo was converted as (Elo−500)/2000×100.

verdicts.summary: I checked all 50 records against the live sources and confirmed every one; no score needed correcting. Sources opened: the Anthropic launch page (raw HTML, including the chart aria-labels, the benchmark table and its footnotes); the Opus 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 system card PDFs (text extracted, with pages 185-186 rendered to read the HLE figure labels); and the leaderboards at tbench.ai TB 4.0, Vals AI Terminal-Bench 4.0 and Terminal-Bench Science, frontierswe.com, zapier.com/benchmarks and the Snorkel Agents' Last Exam board. Verbatim confirmations: the TB4 effort points 38.5/57.6/64.2/66.4/64.8; FrontierCode 47.3/54.6/54.0/51.4/54.4 (Extended 63.6 at max, 65.3 at medium); AutomationBench 23.3/28.6/32.0/34.4/40.0; GDPval-AA Elo 1224/1576/1692/1820/1846, which convert to 36.2/53.8/59.6/66.0/67.3; HLE with tools 57.4/63.0/63.9/66.4/67.7 and without tools 52.9/59.0/59.6/62.8/64.4; the tbench.ai JSON shows accuracy 64.85, n_trials 330, reasoning_effort max; Vals shows 65.15% and the fallback note '22 of 198 ... lowers it from 65.15% to 58.08%' (58.08% is coincidentally also Fable 5.1's score on that table, but the note ties this 58.08 to Opus 5.5); Vals TB-Science v0.1 shows 47.14%; FrontierSWE V2 shows 62.3% ± 9.8 (worst 52.0, best 71.5); Zapier 1.0.6 shows 42.47% and 35.77% and states that leaderboard scores use the held-out private set; Snorkel Overall shows Pass Rate 38.2% and Score 63.2%. The system card confirms DeepSWE v1.1 at 74.2% average over five trials, OSWorld 2.0 at 81.8 partial / 48.7 strict on 108 tasks, and Toolathlon-Verified at 77.8/82.4/72.2 from an internal harness. The Haiku card confirms the offline subset (82 of 108 tasks) at 87.2/53.2, and the Sonnet card confirms 42.5 with re-run fallbacks versus 40.0 without. The comparability flags all follow the column rules. Points to note: the launch page labels the benchmark OSWorld 2.1 while the system card calls it OSWorld 2.0 (September 10, 2026 task files), and the record already says so. TB4 has three records marked matchesPreferred=true (Anthropic xhigh, Anthropic max, and the tbench.ai max run); the column rules allow this, but downstream code should choose only one as primary.

collected.notes:
数据来源：2026-10-12 直接下载并阅读了 Anthropic 发布页（HTML + 图表 aria-label）、Sonnet 5.5 系统卡 PDF（第 109–137 页；HLE 各档 effort 的数值从渲染出的 Figure 8.11.1.A/B 图片上读取）、Haiku 5.5 发布页及其系统卡。

主记录（primaryHint）的取舍：TB4 用发布页 max 档 70.6；FrontierCode 用 max 档 46.2，xhigh 档的 52.1 是该模型的最好成绩，但标为 matchesPreferred=false；OSWorld 用完整 108 题的 partial 分 80.1；GDPval-AA 用发布页的 Elo 1844（归一化后 67.2）。

需要注意的几处差异：
- Haiku 5.5 页面（10-07）把 Sonnet 5.5 的 GDPval-AA 写成 1840，xhigh 写成 1731；Sonnet 系统卡写的是 1844 和 1725。两组数都已记录。
- Haiku 系统卡改用 OSWorld 2.1 离线子集（82 题）重测 Sonnet 5.5，得到 83.9 partial / 48.8 strict。
- 官方榜和自报分有差距：tbench.ai 是 61.82（Claude Code，max），Anthropic 自报 70.6。
- Vals 的 TB-Science 页面上，表格写 45.71%，正文要点写 38.57%，两者不一致。

查过但没找到该模型的地方：DeepSWE 官方榜（服务端渲染只显示 21/28 个模型）、toolathlon.xyz、ALE API、Scale HLE 榜、OSWorld-2 官方 JSON、SciCode 和 CritPt 官网。TB-Science 官方榜（Harbor hub）是客户端渲染，没能读到条目。OpenAI 的 GPT-6.1 Sol 页面返回 403，无法核实其中是否印有 Sonnet 5.5 的对比数字；leads 里也没有其他厂商的对比表。

Haiku 页面重复印出的 Sonnet 5.5 数字（TB4 70.6 及各档、HLE 56.9/64.5 及各档、FrontierCode 52.1 xhigh）和 Sonnet 自家来源完全相同，没有重复记录。按要求未记录 artificialanalysis.ai 自己跑的分数。

verdicts.summary: I checked all 48 records against their sources. All 48 are confirmed and their comparability flags follow the column rules. Sources I opened: the Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 launch pages (the cost-vs-score charts are read from the aria-label data embedded in the HTML), the text of both system cards plus the images of HLE Figures 8.11.1.A and 8.11.1.B, the tbench.ai 4.0 leaderboard JSON, both Vals AI pages, frontierswe.com, and zapier.com/benchmarks. Three details to note, none of which changes a score: (1) Vals AI's Terminal-Bench 4.0 score of 64.14% includes 4 attempts served by the Sonnet 5 fallback; counting those as failures gives 62.63%. (2) On the Vals Terminal-Bench Science page the table says 45.71% (single-run pass@1), but the Key Takeaways text says 38.57%, so the page contradicts itself; I used the table value. (3) The GDPval-AA max-effort score is printed as two different Elo values: 1844 on the Sonnet launch page and system card, 1840 in the reference column of the Haiku page. Both are kept as separate records. The idea that 1840 came from a later re-run is speculation; the page says nothing about why it differs. All Elo-to-score conversions are correct: 1844→67.2, 1725→61.25, 1840→67.0, 1731→61.55, 1551→52.55, 1324→41.2, 1179→33.95.

collected.notes:
All sources were read on 2026-10-12.

Opened directly:
- The Fable 5.1 launch page, including the chart data embedded in its HTML.
- The 212-page Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 system card. I extracted its text and rendered the CritPT figure on p.174 to read the bar values.
- The Anthropic Opus 5.5 launch page and the Opus 5.5 system card. Both include a Fable 5.1 column. Because these are the same vendor's materials, they are recorded as sourceType=official, not vendor_comparison.
- The tbench.ai Terminal-Bench 4.0 board, frontierswe.com and its v2 blog, zapier.com/benchmarks, and three Scale HLE boards (standard, text-only, Diamond).

Choices of primaryHint:
- OSWorld: I picked 80.7 partial from the Opus 5.5 materials. That re-run uses the 2026-09-10 task files and a new harness, the Opus 5.5 card says it supersedes the Fable 5.1 card figures, and the Opus 5.5 page labels it OSWorld 2.1. The original 77.9 from the August task release is kept as a non-primary record.
- FrontierSWE: I picked 56.3 from the Opus 5.5 card. It matches Proximal's blog value of 56.29. The Fable 5.1 card only gives a rounded 0.57.
- FrontierCode Main: the max-effort value of 50.3 comes from the Opus 5.5 page, because the Fable 5.1 card only gives the medium-effort value of 50.9. The best effort is low, at 52.8.
- GDPval-AA: v2.1 (Elo 1735 at max, converted to 61.75) is primary. The v2 values (1853 at max, 1835 at xhigh) are kept with matchesPreferred=false.

Not verified:
- openai.com (the GPT-6 Astra page and the GPT-6 Sol/Luna page) returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare blocks to curl, WebFetch and a reader proxy, and the Wayback Machine was unreachable. The OpenAI vendor_comparison leads therefore could not be checked and were NOT recorded: DeepSWE 67.4, TB4 55.8, FrontierCode Main 50.9 and Extended 63.6, TB-Science 52.6, HLE with tools 65.0, AutomationBench 31.4. They appear to match the Anthropic figures.
- I skipped the Sonnet 5.5 page and card. The leads show they only repeat values already captured.

Lead errors:
- The leads attribute 'xhigh 59.7 (low 41.7, med 46.7, high 57.1, max 60.9)' to Fable 5.1. Those are the Mythos 5.1 sweep values. Fable 5.1's own sweep is low 40.2, med 43.4, high 49.4, xhigh 51.3, max 55.8.

Boards with no Fable 5.1 entry:
- DeepSWE (Datacurve) server-rendered snapshot.
- toolathlon.xyz.
- The Terminal-Bench-Science board, which renders client-side.
- agents-last-exam.org, which renders client-side; a search also found nothing.

Other caveats:
- Scale's own HLE run (46.5 at xhigh, full set) is far below the vendor's 60.9.
- The Zapier board lists Fable 5.1's 31.4% as 'with Opus 5 Fallback': about 40% of tasks were handled by Opus 5. The board excludes that entry from its per-domain rankings as not directly comparable.

Columns in not_found:
- CritPt: the only value found is Anthropic's CritPT-Corrected 88.4, recorded with comparable=false.
- GDP.pdf: only mean-criteria-pass values from Anthropic's internal judge (85.4 without tools, 85.1 with tools), recorded with comparable=false.
- SciCode, AA-LCR and Agents' Last Exam: nothing found from the vendor or the benchmark authors.

verdicts.summary: I checked all 47 records against their URLs. All pages and PDFs opened. 43 records are confirmed as written. 4 need changes. (1) #1: the 60.9 belongs to Claude Mythos 5.1, a sibling, not Fable 5.1. The system card gives Fable 5.1 55.8 under the same setup, which #0 already covers. Delete #1 or treat it as not comparable. (2) #31 (HLE no tools, xhigh 60.36), #36 (HLE with tools, xhigh 65.08) and #42 (GDPval-AA v2.1, xhigh Elo 1721) are xhigh points from effort-curve charts, not the max-effort headline. Their scores are correct, but matchesPreferred should be false. The max-effort records #30, #35 and #41 are the preferred ones. Other checks: every tbench.ai effort entry matches exactly (max and xhigh are both 57.88, n_trials=330). The FrontierSWE blog says 56.29, its main-site chart says mean reward 0.5653, and the Fable card says 0.57; all three are real. Zapier's page states the 31.4% includes Opus 5 fallback runs and is "excluded as not directly comparable". I kept it as comparable under the column rules but flagged it in the fix note. I read the CritPT-Corrected 88.4% off the Figure 8.9.A image. The Opus 5.5 System Card confirms the OSWorld numbers 80.7 partial / 42.8 strict on the 2026-09-10 task release. The Scale HLE boards confirm 46.5 (full set), 46.8 (text-only) and 51.3 (Diamond).

verdicts.summary:
共 71 条，分两类处理。

一、非 OpenAI 来源，均已实时打开核对，全部 confirmed，数字、设置和可比性标记都没有发现错误：
- tbench.ai：Codex harness，max 58.18 / xhigh 57.88 / high 57.88，n_trials 330。
- Vals TB4 59.60%、TBS 62.86%。Vals 模型页写明 Reasoning Effort: max，TB4 页说明分数是 3 次运行的均值。
- Anthropic Opus 5.5 发布页：CSV 表格行和 aria-label 与记录一致；GDPval-AA 的 Elo 换算 1542→52.1、1516→50.8、1485→49.25、1468→48.4、1366→43.3，均正确。
- Datacurve DeepSWE（数据文件为 artifacts/v1.1）：xhigh 0.74115、max 0.73230。
- Cognition FrontierCode 1.1 Main：53.3%。
- FrontierSWE V2：mean@5 65.5%。
- Opus 5.5 System Card 第 179 页：FrontierSWE 65.5%。
- Haiku 5.5 System Card 第 116 页：TBS 68.1%（max），并说明 TB4 57.9% 取的是 high。
- Zapier 1.0.6：Max 41.4%、XHigh 38.96%。
- Snorkel Overall 标签页：Score 59.3、Pass 34.2。
- Scale HLE：全集 54.8、Text Only 54.17。
- Surge GDP.pdf：34.2%。

二、OpenAI 三个页面（gpt-6-astra、introducing-gpt-6-sol-and-luna、introducing-gpt-6-1-sol）：curl、WebFetch、r.jina.ai 和 Wayback 都打不开（403 或拦截）。按规则这 41 条记为 unreachable。我改用本 job 目录里早先保存的官方页面副本（canonical URL 正确的 Next.js 页面）逐条核对，表格行和图表 JSON 数值全部吻合，效果档位标签也都对得上。不少条目另有实时打开的第三方来源佐证：Anthropic 的表格和 aria-label、两份 System Card、Zapier、Snorkel、Datacurve、Cognition。唯独 #25、#28-#32、#42-#45、#53-#56、#66-#69 只出现在保存的副本里，没有其他实时来源能佐证。

几处需要留意：
1. #48（HLE 带工具）OpenAI 没有说明用的题目子集，matchesPreferred=true 证据不足。
2. #66-#69 是 OpenAI 图表的 GDP.pdf 数值（Astra 在 Max 档为 31.0），#70 是 Surge 官方榜（Max 档 34.2），两边不一致，说明二者的口径或运行可能不同。我在 Surge 页面上没有找到 "Score (100% rubrics)" 这一指标原文。
3. #23 写的 "Codex CLI" harness 和 "最佳 effort" 在 Cognition 页面上找不到原文，分数本身没问题。
4. OSWorld 存在两个 max 档 offline 数值：Astra 页表格 72.6，Sol/Luna 页 73.49。两条都已正确标为 offline，matchesPreferred=false。

相关文件：本次实时下载的页面在 source-downloads/dl/astra/（tb.html、vals_*.html、anth.html、deepswe.html、cog.html、fswe.html、zap.html、ale.html、hle*.html、surge.html），两份 System Card PDF 分别在 source-downloads/dl/astra-chk-opuscard/card.pdf 和 source-downloads/dl/astra-chk-haikucard/card.pdf。用来核对的 OpenAI 页面副本是 source-downloads/dl/astra/launch.html 和 source-downloads/dl/astra-sol/{solluna,sol61}.html。

verdicts.summary: I checked all 12 records against their sources. Every score is right and every comparability flag follows the column rules. Sources opened: the Gemini 4 Argon evaluation PDF from Google DeepMind (the results table is an embedded image on page 5, which I extracted and viewed; the methodology notes are on pages 2 and 3), the Vals AI Terminal-Bench 4.0 and Terminal-Bench Science pages, frontierswe.com and zapier.com/benchmarks. There are two small wording issues and no score changes. In #3, the "proximus harness" detail comes from the FrontierSWE board; the PDF itself does not name a harness. In #2, the PDF's exact wording is "mini-swe agent harness". Files downloaded for the check are in source-downloads/dl/argon-pdf/ and source-downloads/dl/web/.

verdicts.fix: PDF 结果表行 Terminal-bench 4.0 | 57.4% | 58.2% | 57.9% | 66.4%；方法说明写明 Gemini 4 Argon 为自测（self computed），未写 harness，记录描述准确。
Vals 榜第 5 行：Gemini 4 Argon Mini-SWE-agent 57.58%。页面写明 avg@3（三次完整运行、每次按 pass@1 计分后取平均），更新于 2026-10-07，与记录一致。
PDF 表行 DeepSWE v1.1 | 77.9%；方法说明原文为 'self computed, using a mini-swe agent harness'。版本是 v1.1，可比。
PDF 表行 FrontierSWE v2 | 55.0%；方法说明为 'reported from Proximal's official public leaderboard'。PDF 本身没写 harness，proximus 来自 FrontierSWE 榜，不影响分数。
frontierswe.com（标 V2）原文：'Google Gemini 4 Argon + proximus: mean@5 55.0%, worst@5 44.5%, best@5 64.3%'；榜注原文：'Cache hit rate is much lower due to a non-production setting'。
PDF 表行 OSWorld-2.0 Offline subset Partial score | 69.2%；方法说明提到 3 次运行取最高、离线子集、1080p、最多 500 步、Gemini CUA harness、08.08 补丁。离线子集记 comparable=true、matchesPreferred=false，符合规则。
PDF 表行 AutomationBench Score | 51.3% | 41.4% | 31.4% | 42.5%；方法说明写明用私有集，数据取自 Zapier 官方公开榜。
Zapier 榜原文：'Leaderboard 1.0.6 ... 1 Gemini 4 Argon (High) 51.29% $1.70*'；页面写明榜单分数在留出的私有评测集上跑，官方指标为严格通过（strict pass）。
Zapier 榜原文：'2 Gemini 4 Argon (Medium) 50.08% $1.54*'；Medium 不是最高档，记 matchesPreferred=false 正确。
PDF 表行 Agent's Last Exam Pass rate | 39.5% | 34.2% | — | 38.2%；方法说明原文：'We report the binary pass rate'，ALE-Claw harness，5 小时窗口，开启安全过滤。按规则这是 Pass rate，应记 comparable=false，记录正确。
PDF 表行 Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 | 57.6% | 68.1% | 52.6% | 63.3%；方法说明原文：'self computed, with 6x verifier timeout'。
Vals 榜第 5 行：Gemini 4 Argon Mini-SWE-agent 44.29% $44.90。页面原文：'All results are pass@1 from a single run per model'，并说明基础设施或服务商错误会重试、对上游 v0.1.0 的 70 题计分，更新于 2026-10-08。

collected.notes:
openai.com 发布页对 curl、WebFetch 和 r.jina.ai 都返回 403，archive 也打不开。官方数字的核验情况如下。

(1) 三个头条数字已在 @OpenAIDevs 官方 X 线程原文核实（经 api.fxtwitter.com 读取）：DeepSWE v1.1 high 档 75.2%，AutomationBench medium 档 31.7%，OSWorld 2.0 offline set max 档 71.4%。帖子配图（DeepSWE、AutomationBench、OSWorld 三张曲线图，无数值标签）的走势与各档数值一致。

(2) 其余各档数值，以及 Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 和 GDP.pdf 的数字，全部来自 AlphaCorp 转载的 OpenAI 发布页图表数据。我抓取了 AlphaCorp 原始 HTML，quote 是原文表格行；OrcaRouter 的转载数字与之一致。这些记录 sourceType 标为 official，但属于二手转载，没有在 openai.com 上直接核实。

(3) OpenAI 系统卡附录（deploymentsafety 页面 / PDF）只有安全、生物、网络安全类评测，16 列一个都没有。

(4) GDP.pdf 的指标是推断：OpenAI 图表未注明指标，但各档数值与 AA GDP.pdf all-pass 榜吻合（该吻合来自搜索摘要，AA 页面本身没有打开），所以推断 OpenAI 引用的是 AA 跑的 all-pass，因此记为 comparable。

(5) OSWorld：OpenAI 用的是离线子集（v2026.08.08，partial reward），所以 matchesPreferred=false。Anthropic Haiku 5.5 系统卡里，Anthropic 自己代跑了 82 个离线任务，partial 76.6、strict 39.8，两个数值都从图 8.9.3.A 读出。

(6) primaryHint 的选法：DeepSWE 选官方头条的 high 档 75.2（各档最高；max 档只有 71.9）；AutomationBench、TB-Science、GDP.pdf 选 max 档；TB4 选 tbench.ai 官方榜的 Codex max 58.18。

(7) 以下榜单均未收录 GPT-6.1 Sol：DeepSWE 官方榜（2026-09-22 更新）、FrontierSWE、Zapier（页面只出前 10，36.1% 应排在第 9 名附近但未见）、ALE（查了 API）、Scale HLE、OSWorld 2 官网。Toolathlon 页面由前端渲染，只看到 Kimi K3，没有看到 GPT-6.1 Sol。

(8) 网上流传的 HLE 52.9、CritPt 24.9–31.7 等数字来自 AA 或其转载，按规则不记录。FrontierCode 搜到的 46.2/52.1 实为 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的分数，不属于本模型。

verdicts.summary: 32 条记录全部核实，状态都是 confirmed，没有需要改数字或可比性标记的地方。核实来源与范围：(1) tbench.ai 的 TB4.0 榜单 HTML：GPT-6.1 Sol 只有一条，Codex/max，accuracy 58.18，n_trials 330，created/updated 2026-10-06。(2) Vals AI 两个榜单页：TB4.0 第 6 名 55.05%，TB-Science 第 2 名 52.86%，都用 Mini-SWE-agent。榜单页本身没写推理档位，"Reasoning Effort: max" 来自 Vals 的模型页 https://www.vals.ai/models/openai_gpt-6.1-sol，该页同时注明部分基准可能使用不同参数。(3) Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card PDF：第 116 页有 TB4 公开榜 58.2% ± 3.1% 和 OpenAI 自报 TB-Science 57.0% 两段原文；第 128 页 Figure 8.9.3.A 渲染出图，确认 GPT-6.1 Sol Partial 76.6、Strict 39.8，并写明 82/108 离线任务、1080p、500 步、max effort、五次尝试。(4) 两条 OpenAIDevs X 帖子通过 api.fxtwitter.com 取到原文，与引用一致；附带的 DeepSWE、AutomationBench、OSWorld 2.0 offline 三张官方图表已下载查看，各档位曲线点与 AlphaCorp 表格吻合。(5) AlphaCorp 文章（2026-09-29）里 DeepSWE v1.1、OSWorld 2.0、GDP.pdf、AutomationBench 1.0.6、TB-Science 0.1 五张表的 GPT-6.1 Sol 行逐字吻合。剩余风险：GDP.pdf 和 TB-Science 的分档数字只有 AlphaCorp 转载，没有找到 OpenAI 原始图表（TB-Science 57.0 已由 Anthropic 转述佐证）。GDP.pdf 的指标是否为 all-pass 在来源中没有写明，comparable=true 属于推断。AutomationBench 1.0.6 是否就是 Zapier 的私有 held-out 集也没有写明。#2 与 #0、#26 与 #20 是同一底层数字被另一来源转引，可以保留，但 primaryHint 应分别放在 #0 和 #20。

verdicts.summary:
I checked all 15 records against their own URLs. All 15 are confirmed: each number belongs to Muse Spark 1.3 itself, not a sibling model, and the comparability flags follow the column rules.

Meta's article URL in the image path (research.meta.ai/articles/introducing-muse-1-3/) returns 404. The scorecard image itself opens fine, and the live launch post is https://research.meta.ai/blog/introducing-muse-spark-1-3. The setting details in records #0 to #4 come from Meta's methodology PDF at https://research.meta.ai/static/muse-spark-1-3-multimodal-evaluation-methodology, not from the image. That PDF confirms: OSWorld 2.0 has 108 tasks, uses partial score as the primary metric and binary as the secondary one, and was run on version 08.08 (Muse Spark 1.2 on 06.24). AutomationBench used the public v3 set of 600 workflows, so comparable=false is correct. DeepSWE v1.1 has 113 tasks and Meta ran 1.3 max with mini-swe-agent. GDPVal-AA v2 ran in Artificial Analysis's Stirrup harness; (1754−500)/2000×100 = 62.7. Some third-party sites print 49.4 for AutomationBench, but the image clearly shows 49.6.

On tbench.ai the Muse Code / xhigh row reads accuracy 14.55 with n_trials 330. On Vals AI, the Terminal-Bench 4.0 page says results are avg@3. The Terminal-Bench Science page says results are pass@1 from one run per model, so it is not avg@3. FrontierSWE V2 shows 25.8% mean@5 (34 tasks, 5 trials per task, 20-hour budget), with no effort level given. In the Agents' Last Exam JSON API, the full split for max and xhigh matches all four records. passRate is computed against all 152 tasks in the split, not just the 148 that were run (45/152 = 0.296).

collected.notes:
I recorded 13 entries across 6 benchmarks. Each number was checked against the original source on 2026-10-12.

Vendor sources:
- The launch page covers DeepSWE v1.1, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and GDPval.
- The model card covers DeepSWE, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and FrontierSWE V2.
- Neither source has HLE, OSWorld, Toolathlon, Agents' Last Exam (ALE), SciCode, CritPt, GDP.pdf or AA-LCR. The figure "xAI reports HLE 46.3%" in third-party search summaries is probably the CursorBench 4.0 score (46.3) mislabeled, so I did not record it.

Conflicts between sources:
- Terminal-Bench 4.0: the launch page says 37.6, the model card body says 38.0, and the official tbench.ai board says 37.58. The launch page is primaryHint.
- FrontierSWE: the model card says 29.0 and the official Proximal board currently says 29.5.

GDPval: the launch page chart is labeled only "GDPval" (Elo 1695, xhigh). The Artificial Analysis article confirms 1695 is a GDPval-AA result but does not say v2 or v2.1. I converted it to 59.75 and set matchesPreferred=false.

FrontierCode: the scores come from the data.json that the Cognition board loads at runtime. The Score field equals new_score; I checked the mapping against Opus 5.5 medium (0.5464, shown as 54.6%) and Grok 4.6 high (0.4801, shown as 48.0%). Grok 4.7 is available at high and xhigh:
- xhigh is the top effort: 45.59, primaryHint.
- high is its best effort: 47.59, matchesPreferred=false.
- The Extended set score (59.4) is recorded with comparable=false.

Board checks with no Grok 4.7 entry:
- DeepSWE (21 of 28 models visible, no Grok 4.7 row)
- Zapier AutomationBench v1.0.6 (126 rows parsed in full, no Grok)
- ALE API (only Grok 4.5 / 4.3 / 3)
- Toolathlon
- Scale HLE
- OSWorld 2
- CritPt
- tbench.ai Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 board

Vals AI independently reran Terminal-Bench 4.0 (28.79, mini-SWE-agent, avg@3) and Terminal-Bench Science v0.1 (10.00, mini-SWE-agent, single run) as a third party. The Science entry is the only score in that column.

No other vendor's comparison table was found that prints Grok 4.7 numbers for these benchmarks. Per the instructions, I did not record any Artificial Analysis-run numbers.

verdicts.summary:
I opened all 13 records' sources myself and confirmed every number, setting and comparability flag; nothing needed correcting. Sources checked: the x.ai/news/grok-4-7 launch page, the model card PDF (media.x.ai 4p7card), the Terminal-Bench 4.0 leaderboard on tbench.ai, the Cognition FrontierCode data.json, the Devin blog post, two Vals AI pages (TB4 and TB-Science) and frontierswe.com.

Two things to note:
1. Terminal-Bench 4.0 has two official numbers: 37.6 in the launch-page table and 38.0 in the model card. The official leaderboard shows 37.58, which matches 37.6 after rounding. When choosing primaryHint, prefer the launch page's 37.6 (#0) or the leaderboard's 37.58 (#2).
2. FrontierCode lists only two effort levels for Grok 4.7: high and xhigh. Max effort is therefore xhigh at 45.59 (#6), so that record matchesPreferred=true. The high-effort score of 47.59 (#7) is actually the higher of the two; it was correctly marked matchesPreferred=false.

GDPval (#12): the launch page labels it only "GDPval" with an Elo axis and does not state the version. That is consistent with Artificial Analysis's Elo-based GDPval-AA, which the launch page itself does not name. matchesPreferred=false is reasonable.

collected.notes:
Xiaomi's own material has 6 numbers that match our columns. All come from one shared table: the HF model card for MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL, Table 3 of the tech report, and the appendix of the launch blog (data in bench.js) all show the same values. For each number I recorded only the HF card. The launch blog is dated 2026-09-22.

The vendor gives DeepSWE v1.1 71.9, AutomationBench v1.0.6 53.1, Toolathlon-Verified 76.9, TB4.0 34.9 and GDPval-AA v2.1 Elo 1673 (converted to 58.65). It also gives Agents' Last Exam 31.6. The table does not name that metric, but the baseline columns match the passRate field in the ALE official data, so it is a Pass rate and is marked comparable=false. The vendor also reports OSWorld-Verified 82.0 and Terminal Bench 2.1 89.9; both are excluded benchmarks and were not recorded. The vendor uses the AA Intelligence Index 46.32 as its headline, which is not one of our columns.

The tech report only says that baseline models were run at max effort. It does not give MiMo's own harness, effort or number of trials.

Benchmark-author boards: tbench.ai TB4.0 and TB-Science, deepswe.datacurve.ai, frontierswe.com, zapier.com/benchmarks, toolathlon.xyz (only MiMo V2.5), agents-last-exam.org (its API has only mimo-v2-5), the Scale HLE board, and the Snorkel OSWorld 2.0 page and osworld-v2.xlang.ai. MiMo-V2.6-Pro appears on none of them.

Third-party: Vals AI ran TB4.0 (mini-SWE-agent, avg@3) and got 31.31. Its Sep 22 update text had said 24.75. Vals ran TB-Science v0.1.0 (single pass@1) and got 2.86.

Two searches found no other vendor printing MiMo-V2.6-Pro numbers in its own comparison table. The leads file's printed_by_other_vendors list was also empty.

Do not mix up the family: the HF model card lists MiMo-V2.6-Flash and MiMo-V2.5-Pro in neighbouring columns of the same table. The MOPD checkpoint card (2026-09-27) has no evaluation table.

verdicts.summary: All 8 records hold up. The official HF model card (README) Section 3 table and Table 3 on p.26 of the technical report (MiMo_V2_6_technical_report.pdf) both list the same MiMo-V2.6 Pro values: DeepSWE v1.1 71.9, AutomationBench v1.0.6 53.1, Toolathlon-Verified 76.9, GDPval-AA 2.1 1673, Agents' Last Exam 31.6, Terminal Bench 4.0 34.9. The tech report only says baselines were run at max effort; it states no harness or trial count for MiMo itself. It calls GDPval-AA v2.1 "Artificial Analysis's evaluation framework for GDPval" but does not explicitly say AA produced the Elo. The blog mimo.xiaomi.com/mimo-v2-6 is a client-rendered page, curl got no body text, so I could not verify the claim that the blog appendix says these are AA-reported Elos. The two Vals pages match the claims: TB4 shows 15th place, 31.31%, Mini-SWE-agent, updated 10/7/2026, avg@3 (each run pass@1). TBS shows 31st place, 2.86%, single-run pass@1, all 70 tasks from v0.1.0, strict pass/fail, updated 10/8/2026. Neither page says whether Xiaomi's official API was used, so that detail is unverified. For Agents' Last Exam I pulled the official board API (agents-last-exam.org/api/demo/leaderboard). Xiaomi's baseline values match the official passRate scale, e.g. Claude Fable 5 reasoning-xhigh passRate 25.66% vs 25.7 in Xiaomi's table, while avgScore sits around 48-55%. So reading 31.6 as Pass rate and setting comparable=false is sound. MiMo-V2.6 Pro is not on that board. It is also not on zapier.com/benchmarks, so the AutomationBench number is vendor self-reported only.

collected.notes:
I found five comparable scores that are explicitly for the 0902 version. Three come from Qwen's own launch table: DeepSWE 1.1 at 69.3, AutomationBench v1.0.6 at 50.8 and Toolathlon Verified at 73.3. Two come from benchmark leaderboards: Terminal-Bench 4.0 at 26.97 on tbench.ai (Claude Code, max effort), and FrontierSWE v2 mean@5 at 17.8.

The launch material consists of the X post plus two images; one is the benchmark table, the other a poster with no numbers. The QwenCloud model page and the Alibaba Cloud notice give no scores. The vendor table only lists TerminalBench 3.0 at 29.0, which is a different benchmark, so I did not record it. The table has no OSWorld 2, HLE, SciCode, CritPt, GDPval-AA or GDP.pdf rows.

Several leaderboard rows could not be tied to the 0902 version, so I excluded them:
- **DeepSWE leaderboard:** only lists "qwen3.8-max" at xhigh effort, pass@1 0.5746. That row carries no version suffix and is probably the original release.
- **Agents' Last Exam API (`/api/demo/leaderboard`):** has a "qwen-3-8-max" row (Claude Code, thinking-xhigh; full split avgScore 0.5249, passRate 0.2697). It also has no version marker, so it cannot be confirmed as 0902.
- **Vals AI Terminal-Bench 4.0:** its 34.34 is labelled "Qwen 3.8 Max", and the model page says "released August 3, 2026", so it is the original version.

Several sources had nothing for Qwen at all: Toolathlon (toolathlon.xyz), Zapier's leaderboard, Scale's HLE board, Snorkel's OSWorld 2.0 page, the OSWorld v2 site and the FrontierCode site. The MiMo-V2.6 comparison table does not include Qwen either.

Only Qwen's own footnote says AutomationBench was run after PR #16. The source does not say whether it used Zapier's private held-out set. I did not record any artificialanalysis.ai numbers, as instructed.

verdicts.summary: All 5 records are confirmed. The numbers, the model name (Qwen3.8-Max-0902, not its sibling Qwen3.8-Max), and the settings all match the sources I opened. Image (pbs.twimg.com/media/HRLPmfLagAA9ATq.jpg): DeepSWE 1.1 69.3 (footnote 3 says mini-SWE-agent, temp=1.0, top_p=0.95, 1M context), Automation Bench v1.0.6 (Pass@1) 50.8 (footnote 10 says the run came after incorporating PR #16), Toolathlon Verified (Pass@1) 73.3. tbench.ai TB 4.0 board: Claude Code harness, reasoning_effort=max, accuracy 26.97, n_trials 330, successes 89. frontierswe.com (page badge reads V2): 'Qwen Qwen3.8-Max-0902 + proximus: mean@5 17.8%, worst@5 8.1%, best@5 26.8%'. Two minor caveats. First, AutomationBench: Qwen ran the benchmark itself from the public GitHub repo, so the score may not come from Zapier's private held-out set. Second, on the TB4 board, Sep 2, 2026 is the display date, while the record was created on 2026-10-06. The same image also shows TerminalBench 3.0 at 29.0, which is a different benchmark and is correctly not recorded.

- FrontierSWE 有 GLM-5.3，mean@5 30.2。
- Zapier AutomationBench 1.0.6 没有 GLM-5.3，只有 GLM 5.2 和 5.1。
- Toolathlon 只有 GLM 5.3 Flash。
- ALE 官方 API 只有 GLM-5.2 和 GLM-5.1。
- Scale HLE 只有 GLM-4.5。
- CritPt 和 OSWorld 2 站点都没有 GLM。

ALE：厂商给的 28.5 是 105 题 linux_only 子集的 pass rate。依据是同表其他模型的厂商数字与官方 API 中该子集的 passRate 完全一致。因此标记为不可比。

AutomationBench：48.2 是厂商用公开 v1.0.6 自测的结果，不是 Zapier 私有保留题集，因此标记为不可比。

HLE w/ tools：模型卡没有写题集。按 GLM-5 技术报告的纯文本子集惯例处理，记为 comparable=true、matchesPreferred=false。

StepFun Step 5 Preview 的对比表也印有 GLM-5.3 的数字：TB4 41.9、HLE 42.3、SciCode 59.0、CritPt 19.1、AA-LCR 79.7、GDPval-AA v2 1634 等，看起来多半是 AA 数据。但我只找到非官方的 HF 镜像（SHSLab/Step-5-Preview-BF16），没能打开 StepFun 官方页面（stepfun-ai 官方 HF 仓库返回 401）。所以这些数字没有作为 vendor_comparison 记录。

有一处疏忽：一次 curl 因 cd 失败，把 p1.html 和 p2.html 写进了 worktree 根目录。我已把它们移到 source-downloads/dl/glm53misc/，worktree 里没有留下其他改动。

verdicts.summary:
12 条记录我都逐一打开了来源，全部核实无误（confirmed），需要修正的一条也没有。比较规则的标注（comparable_ok）也都符合各列规则。

来源和下载方式：
- Hugging Face 模型卡用 raw README.md 下载核对：DeepSWE 66.9、FrontierSWE 78.1、Toolathlon Verified 73.0、AutomationBench 48.2、ALE-CLI 28.5、HLE w/ Tools 62.5、GDPval-AA v2 1769。各条脚注原文也对得上。
- tbench.ai 4.0 榜的 JSON 里能找到 accuracy 41.82、n_trials 330、reasoning_effort max、Claude Code、日期 2026-08-14。
- Vals AI 两个榜：TB4 是 38.89%，页面写明 avg@3，更新于 10/7/2026；TB Science 是 5.71%，写明 pass@1、单次运行、上游 v0.1.0 全部 70 题，更新于 10/8/2026。
- DeepSWE 官方榜（v1.1，113 题，updated September 22, 2026）上 glm-5.3 [max] 是 69%。
- FrontierSWE V2 榜（mean@5，34 题）上 GLM-5.3 是 30.2%，mean reward 0.3018 over 170 runs。

两处说明：
1. ALE 那条标成 Pass rate、comparable=false，我额外查了证据。ALE 官方接口 /api/demo/leaderboard 的 linux_only 子集（105 题）里，模型卡同表其他模型的分数都和 passRate 一致，和 avgScore 不一致，例如 Kimi K3 27.6、GLM-5.2 23.8、Opus 4.8 max 25.7、Fable 5 xhigh 23.8。所以 28.5 是通过率，标注正确。官方榜上暂时还没有 GLM-5.3 这一行。
2. HLE w/ Tools 那条，模型卡没有写是全集还是纯文本子集，记录里“推测只测纯文本子集”属于推断。matchesPreferred=false 是偏保守的处理，可以保留，但应该写明这是未证实的推测。

collected.notes:
I checked these sources directly: the official Hugging Face model card, the technical report PDF (Table 2 matches the model card) and the launch blog footnotes.

What Moonshot's own material reports:
- Terminal-Bench: only TB 2.1 (88.3). This is not recorded.
- OSWorld: OSWorld-Verified 84.8 (not recorded) and OSWorld 2.0 58.3. The OSWorld 2.0 column is not labeled partial or binary. I infer it is the partial score because, in the same table, the GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.6 Sol values (49.5 / 62.6) match the partial scores on the Snorkel board.
- AutomationBench: run on the 600-task public subset, so comparable=false.
- Agents' Last Exam: reports the pass rate, so comparable=false. The comparable Score (avgScore) comes from the ALE official API: Kimi Code 51.58, Claude Code 50.72. I cross-checked against the GPT-6 Astra row in the same API (avgScore 0.5926 = 59.3) to confirm that avgScore is the Score metric.
- FrontierSWE: reports the dominance score 81.2, so comparable=false. The official mean@5 is 25.9.
- CritPt, SciCode, AA-LCR and GDPval-AA v2 (1686 Elo) are AA numbers cited by Moonshot (as of 2026-07-23), so they are recorded as official.

Leaderboards where Kimi K3 is missing:
- tbench.ai TB 4.0 and TB-Science
- Zapier AutomationBench
- Scale HLE (only shows kimi-k2.5)
- Snorkel OSWorld 2.0

Vendor comparison: the leads list none. As an extra check I only looked at the GLM-5.3 Hugging Face card, which includes a Kimi K3 column. I did not check the comparison tables from Qwen, MiMo, Step, Ling or DeepSeek; the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3-Flash cards do not mention Kimi.

Vals TB4 17.17 and TB-Science 1.43 are third-party runs (mini-SWE-agent).

verdicts.summary: I opened all 28 records' sources and checked the numbers. All 28 are confirmed and none need correcting. The sources were the Kimi K3 HF model card plus the technical report PDF, the GLM-5.3 HF model card, the DeepSWE v1.1 leaderboard-live.json, the FrontierSWE homepage, the Toolathlon homepage (the Toolathlon-Verified table), the ALE /api/demo/leaderboard JSON, and the two Vals AI pages. Key points checked: (1) The Kimi model card footnotes confirm several things. The HLE-Full cells read without tools / with tools in that order. Top-p for HLE-Full is 0.95. DeepSWE is v1.1 run with the Kimi Code harness, and the card also cites 67.3 for mini-SWE-agent on the official board. FrontierSWE is a dominance score (comparable=false is correct). AutomationBench is the 600-task public subset (not the private held-out set, so comparable=false is correct). ALE uses the primary pass-rate metric (comparable=false is correct). SciCode, CritPt, AA-LCR and GDPval-AA v2 are cited from AA as of 2026-07-23. Section 6.1.3 of the technical report says Toolathlon-Verified is cited from the official board as of 2026-07-24. (2) OSWorld 2.0 does not say partial or binary on the card. The OSWorld 2.0 paper abstract (arXiv 2606.29537) gives Opus 4.8 a binary completion rate of 20.6% and a partial score of 54.8%, and GPT-5.5 a binary rate of about 13%. The Kimi table shows Opus 4.8 at 55.7 and GPT-5.5 at 49.5, which matches the partial scale. So 58.3 is very likely a partial score, and comparable=true holds, though this is an inference. (3) The DeepSWE leaderboard JSON (generated_at 2026-09-22) has kimi-k3 / mini-swe-agent / max with pass_at_1=0.68514, n_attempted=451 and n_runs=4, so 68.5 is right. (4) The Toolathlon row sits in the Toolathlon-Verified table (released 2026-06-30, 108 tasks): Kimi K3 (max), Default, 2026-07-16, 76.5 ± 1.9. (5) In the ALE JSON, passRate = passes / splitTasks (43/152 = 0.2829) and avgScore = 0.5158. The Claude Code harness row is 41/152 = 0.2697 and 0.5072. (6) Vals TB4 is Version 4.0, updated 10/7/2026, scored avg@3 (the mean of three full runs), with Kimi K3 at 17.17%. Vals TB-Science was updated 10/8/2026, with Kimi K3 at 1.43%. (7) The GDPval-AA conversions are right: 1686 gives 59.3 and 1682 gives 59.1. (8) In the GLM-5.3 table, Kimi K3 shows HLE w/ Tools 59.8, DeepSWE (v1.1) 67.5, Toolathlon Verified 76.5, ALE-CLI 27.6 (GLM's footnote says 105 tasks with the Claude Code harness), AutomationBench v1.0.6 46.7, and GDPval-AA v2 1682. The footnotes do not say who ran the Kimi K3 HLE or DeepSWE numbers; the 67.5 is the same as Kimi's own Kimi Code result. Files are in source-downloads/dl/k3/, k3pdf/ and lb/.

verdicts.summary:
I checked all 37 records against the live sources. Every number is confirmed and every comparability flag follows the column rules. No corrections were needed.

Sources opened:
- The Anthropic launch page at https://www.anthropic.com/claude-haiku-5-5. Its benchmark table shows TB4 39.2, FrontierCode Main 46.4, OSWorld 2.1 offline subset 72.4, HLE 45.9 without tools and 57.4 with tools, and GDPval-AA v2.1 Elo 1620. The page source also holds the four effort-curve CSV data blocks (TB4, OSWorld, GDPval-AA, HLE no tools), and every Haiku 5.5 row in them matches the claims.
- The system card PDF. Table 8.1.A shows FrontierCode 1.1 (Main) as "46.4 (max) 45.8 (xhigh)". The text also supports these claims:
  - §8.3: 58.4% on Extended, Main is the 100 hardest of 150 tasks, and Cognition ran the evaluation in Claude Code.
  - §8.4: 39.2% on TB4, averaged over 10 trials per task (660 trials), Claude Code --bare at max effort, no fallback model, no internet egress.
  - §8.5: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 at 20.6%, with 700 trials over 70 tasks.
  - §8.6: FrontierSWE v2 at 43.8%, run by Proximal on all 34 tasks × 5 trials.
  - §8.8.1: HLE is a 2,500-question multimodal set, run with thinking auto, a 980k task budget, no compaction, and Claude Opus 4.6 as grader.
  - §8.9.3: OSWorld 2.1 offline subset (82 of 108 tasks, 1080p, at most 500 steps), partial score 72.4 and strict pass rate 37.1.
  - §8.10.2: medium is the default effort, with Elo 1277 at that setting.
- Cognition data.json, block v1_1 → "Claude Haiku 5.5" → data: the main new_score values per effort (max 0.4636, xhigh 0.4583, high 0.4189, medium 0.4163, low 0.3476) match.
- frontierswe.com: in the "mean" block, the Haiku 5.5 + proximus row has overall 43.76868294117648, and the chart title reads "mean reward 0.4377 over 170 runs". The other two "overall" values for Haiku on the page (52.75 and 34.49) sit in the "best" and "worst" blocks, so the record correctly took the mean.
- Vals AI TB4: row 12 shows Haiku 5.5, Mini-SWE-agent, 35.35%. The methodology states results are avg@3. The Vals model page states "Compute Effort: max" and that Haiku 5.5 ran without a refusal fallback.
- Vals TB-Science: row 15 shows 10.00%, described as "pass@1 from a single run per model" on upstream v0.1.0.
- Scale HLE boards: the main board shows score 30.12 (rank 12, createdAt 2026-10-08) and the Text Only board shows 30.35 (rank 11).

The GDPval-AA normalizations all compute correctly: 1620→56.0, 1513→50.65, 1420→46.0, 1277→38.85, 1125→31.25.

One minor wording issue: in #6, the "Xhigh" at the end of the quoted table row is the label on Sonnet 5.5's 52.1. Haiku's 46.4 is the max-effort number (system card: "scored best at max effort: 46.4% on Main"), so the record itself is correct.

(1) AutomationBench 厂商值 15.2 与 Zapier 当前 v1.0.6 私有集榜单的 23.59 差距较大，推测基准版本不同。合并时如需与其它模型统一按 v1.0.6 口径，应改用 23.59。

(3) OSWorld 发布页没有写明 partial/binary 和全集/子集；partial 是根据 Snorkel 榜上 Sol 的 Partial 值 62.72 推断的。

verdicts.summary: I checked all 54 records. Each number appears at its URL for GPT-5.6 Terra itself, not a sibling model. 0 records corrected, not_found or unreachable. Method: curl to the original page. openai.com returns 403 to normal curl and to WebFetch, but returns the full page (1.4 MB) when requested with a Slackbot User-Agent. Its tables and chart data match the claims: ALE 50.4, GDPval-AA v2 1,593 Elo, DeepSWE v1.1 69.6, OSWorld 2.0 50.2, gdp.pdf 24.7, AutomationBench 15.2, Toolathlon 53.1. The chart data has a Terra point for each effort level from low to max (some charts also include none), and the values match one by one. All 5 GDPval Elo-to-score conversions are correct. Datacurve leaderboard-live.json (scope 113 tasks, generated_at 2026-09-22) matches on all 5 effort levels. Cognition data.json, key v1_1, matches on new_score. The page JS confirms new_score is the 'Score' the leaderboard shows; correct is the 'Pass rate'. The Zapier version 1.0.6 data sits in a Framer mjs script. The tbench.ai page source has rank 27, accuracy 21.52, n_trials 330. Page 9 of the Grok 4.7 Model Card has 'GPT-5.6 Terra (max) 21.5%' and the Harbor footnote. Vals TB4 shows 22.73% (updated 2026-10-07, mean of three pass@1 runs). Vals TB-Science shows 10.00% (updated 2026-10-08). ALE /api/demo/leaderboard: avgScore and passRate match exactly on the full split for all 5 effort levels. All comparability flags follow the column rules. Points not verified: (1) The OpenAI page does not say whether OSWorld 2.0 is a partial or binary score. WebSearch summaries of several aggregator sites (Yutori, BenchmarkList and others) list 50.2 as a partial score; I could not open Yutori directly. (2) The OpenAI page does not define the gdp.pdf metric, so all-pass is an inference. (3) The OpenAI page does not state an effort level for its table numbers. Most match the chart max points; Toolathlon and gdp.pdf have no chart to compare. (4) Single-run and effort details for Vals TB-Science are not shown on the page. Sources: https://openai.com/index/gpt-5-6/ , https://www.tbench.ai/leaderboard/terminal-bench/4.0 , https://media.x.ai/v1/website/4p7card-5eccc980.pdf , https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/terminal-bench-4 , https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/terminal-bench-science , https://deepswe.datacurve.ai/artifacts/v1.1/leaderboard-live.json , https://cognition.com/data/frontiercode-leaderboard/data.json , https://zapier.com/benchmarks , https://agents-last-exam.org/api/demo/leaderboard , https://yutori.com/leaderboards/osworld-2 (found by search but the page did not load). Downloaded files are in source-downloads/dl/v1/.

collected.notes: The vendor's launch blog (its table is embedded in the page JS) lists more benchmarks than the HF card image. Beyond the image's six, it adds Toolathlon Verified 78.4, OSWorld 2.0 59.1 and NL2Repo 56.3; NL2Repo is outside the 16 columns. The vendor's Terminal Bench 2.1 score (84.3) is a different benchmark and is not recorded. ALE 26.3 matches the official board's pass rate for the comparison models (Opus 4.8 at 27.0, GLM-5.2 at 20.4), so it is marked non-comparable, and agents-last-exam goes in not_found. OSWorld 2.0 59.1 is not labeled partial or binary. It is inferred to be partial because the same table's Opus 4.8 value of 54.8 equals the official partialScore. The model is absent from the Zapier AutomationBench, ALE, OSWorld 2, tbench Science and Scale HLE boards. Vals' Terminal-Bench 4.0 board does not list the Flash variant either; only GLM 5.3 is there. Artificial Analysis numbers were deliberately left out, except the vendor-printed GDPval-AA v2 Elo of 1773. No other vendor's comparison table showing this model was found in the leads.

verdicts.summary: I opened all 12 records' sources (Z.ai blog JS bundle, deepswe.datacurve.ai, tbench.ai 4.0, frontierswe.com, toolathlon.xyz, vals.ai, plus the agents-last-exam.org API, the official OSWorld 2.0 page and the Zapier board for cross-checks). All 12 numbers appear verbatim for GLM-5.3-Flash, and the comparability flags follow the column rules. Points to tighten: (1) The blog's DeepSWE footnote only says mini-swe-agent, temperature=0.95, top_p=1.0, 6h, 400K; it never says max effort, so "默认 max effort" in #0 is an inference. (2) The OSWorld 2.0 metric in #4 can be confirmed as Partial Score: the Opus 4.8 comparison value in the same table is 54.8, and the official osworld-v2.xlang.ai page says "Claude Opus 4.8 ... completes only 20.6% of tasks at a 54.8% partial score". (3) The ALE value in #8 can be confirmed as Pass rate: in the ALE API the full-split pass rates are glm-5-2 claude_code max 0.2039, claude-opus-4-8 thinking-max 0.2697 and GPT-5.6-Terra reasoning-max 0.2796, which match the blog's 20.4/27/28. The API has no GLM-5.3-Flash row. (4) The Zapier official board has no GLM-5.3-Flash. Zapier states that leaderboard scores come from a private held-out set and that the 600 public tasks are for research only. The vendor's v1.0.6 run, with the PR #13 fix applied, was most likely on the public set, so matchesPreferred=false in #7 is appropriate. (5) In #2, tbench.ai labels reasoning_effort as none, and it is the only GLM-5.3-Flash entry.

collected.notes:
I found only one piece of vendor launch material: the official @AntLingAGI X post from 2026-09-30 and its 12-panel chart (I downloaded the image and read the values off it). The model is API-only for now. Hugging Face has no inclusionAI/Ling-3.1-flash card (request returned 401), and I found no official blog or tech report.

Of the 16 columns, the chart covers four: GDPval-AA v2.1, Terminal-Bench 4.0, FrontierSWE and AutomationBench (public). The other chart panels are not in our 16 columns: tau3-Banking, SkillsBench, CyberGym, SWE Atlas QnA, Finance Agent v2, HealthBench Professional, DRACO and MultiChallenge.

- **FrontierSWE (not comparable):** the vendor's 75.16 is not mean@5. The same chart gives GLM 5.3 74.34 and Kimi K3 73.52, while Proximal's official board shows 30.2% and 25.9% mean@5 for those models.
- **AutomationBench (not comparable):** the 52.5 is on the public set, not Zapier's private held-out set.

On 2026-10-12 I checked these benchmark-author boards and none of them list Ling 3.1 Flash: tbench.ai TB 4.0 (parsed model labels), tbench.ai TB-Science 0.1, deepswe.datacurve.ai, frontierswe.com, zapier.com/benchmarks, toolathlon.xyz, agents-last-exam.org, Scale HLE, and the Vals TB4 and Vals Index boards. A 'ling' hit on frontierswe.com turned out to be Thinking Machines Inkling. No other vendor's comparison table that I saw includes this model.

verdicts.summary: I downloaded the vendor chart (https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HTelU-lbgAQs5K-.jpg?name=orig, 1969x1228) and read it directly. All four Ling-3.1-flash numbers match the chart, and all four comparability flags follow the column rules, so every record is confirmed. GDPval-AA v2.1 shows 1673, and (1673-500)/2000×100 = 58.65. Terminal-Bench 4.0 shows 40.40. FrontierSWE shows 75.16, and Automationbench (public) shows 52.50. On FrontierSWE, the official board at frontierswe.com uses the proximus harness and lists GLM-5.3 at 30.2% and Kimi K3 at 25.9%. The vendor chart puts the same two models at 74.34 and 73.52, so its metric is not the official mean@5 score, and comparable=false is justified. Ling 3.1 Flash does not appear on the official FrontierSWE board. AutomationBench is marked public, not Zapier's private held-out set, so comparable=false is correct. One limit: I did not open the tweet text itself, only the chart image. The quoted tweet phrases ("1,673 Elo on GDPVal-AA v2.1", "75.16 on FrontierSWE") are therefore unverified, but the numbers in them match the chart.

verdicts.summary: I opened all 15 records at their URLs. Every number appears for Gemini 3.8 Flash itself, and all comparability flags follow the column rules, so all 15 are confirmed with no corrections. How I checked: the Google model card's first column is Gemini 3.8 Flash. Its methods PDF (storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/gemini/gemini_3-8_flash_model_evaluation.pdf) confirms four settings: the TB4 number comes from the official board at the highest-scoring thinking level; DeepSWE was self-run with mini-swe-agent at high; GDPVal-AA v2 comes from Artificial Analysis's board; OSWorld 2.0 is the partial score, best of 3 runs, batched tool calls, run before the 08.08 patch. Other sources: the tbench.ai data has accuracy 19.09 with n_trials 330 (mini-SWE-agent, high). Vals TB4 is 19.19% (avg@3, three refusals by this model scored as failures). Vals TB-Science is 8.57% (single run pass@1, all 70 tasks of v0.1.0). The DeepSWE v1.1 board shows "74 % ± 1 %" (updated September 22, 2026); its underlying data gives pass_at_1 = 0.7383. FrontierSWE V2 lists mean reward 0.1963 over 170 runs; on the main table Google is represented only by Gemini 4 Argon. Scale HLE gives 44.52 for the full set and 44.95 for text-only; the boards announce HLE-Rolling but still use the original HLE. The Google Cloud guide shows 45.4%. Page 131 of the Haiku 5.5 card, in section 8.10.2 'GDPval-AA v2.1', gives Elo 1435, run by Artificial Analysis.

verdicts.summary:
I checked all 18 records against the live pages: 18 confirmed, 0 corrected, 0 not found, 0 unreachable. The comparability flags all follow the column rules.

- **HF model card (raw README):** All values match the "Qwen3.8-Max" column. The card says Qwen3.8-Max is "the official version based on Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B". The records cover DeepSWE 1.1 (56.6), FrontierSWE (73.5), Automation-Bench (27.3), Toolathlon Verified (72.5), Agents' Last Exam (27.0 pass / 52.4 score), HLE (43.6) and HLE w/ tools (56.2).
  - Footnote 4 confirms the Claude Code / mini-SWE-agent best-of-two harness with temp=1.0, top_p=0.95 and 256K context.
  - Footnote 16 confirms the Automation-Bench 600-task public subset.
  - The 73.5 FrontierSWE value is not mean@5. Proximal's official mean@5 for Qwen3.8-Max is 15.8, and footnote 6 says the dominance scores were recomputed. So comparable=false is correct.
- **DeepSWE leaderboard-live.json:** Confirms qwen3-8-max with mini-swe-agent at xhigh: pass_at_1 0.57461, n_runs 4, 113 tasks. n_attempted is 449, not exactly 113×4=452.
- **frontierswe.com (FrontierSWE V2, 34 tasks, 5 trials, 20-hour budget):** "Qwen3.8-Max: 15.8% mean@5" is confirmed. The board also lists a separate snapshot, "Qwen3.8-Max-0902: 17.8% mean@5" (worst@5 8.1%, best@5 26.8%, proximus harness). That entry was not recorded; add it as a separate record.
- **Vals AI:** Terminal-Bench 4.0 shows 34.34% (Mini-SWE-agent). Vals notes nine provider refusals on Qwen were scored as failures. Terminal-Bench Science shows 12.86% (Mini-SWE-agent), with all 70 tasks from upstream v0.1.0.
- **reflection.ai/beam:** I confirmed the column order (the 7th value column is "Qwen 3.8 Max"). DeepSWE v1.1 is 51.0, AutomationBench public 39.8, HLE no tools 43.6, SciCode 52.1, CriPT AA 20.0 and AA-LCR 80.3. Reflection says other models' scores come from Artificial Analysis and DataCurve. So the SciCode, CritPt, AA-LCR and HLE no-tools values are probably AA-derived and may duplicate data we already have; do not mark them primaryHint.

**primaryHint suggestions:**
- DeepSWE, HLE no tools, HLE with tools, Toolathlon and Agents' Last Exam Score: use the vendor HF card records (#0, #10, #12, #7, #8).
- FrontierSWE: use #3.
- Automation-Bench: no comparable record exists.

verdicts.summary: 2026-10-12 下载了官方 Hugging Face 模型卡 README（https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next/raw/main/README.md），逐条核对 7 条记录，全部确认。表头确认第一列就是 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，所以分数不是同系列其他型号的。核到的数值：DeepSWE 1.1 为 58.7，脚注写明两个 harness 取较高分、本模型在 mini-SWE-agent 上最好；Agents' Last Exam 为 Pass@1 24.3、Score 51.2；Toolathlon Verified (Pass@1) 为 73.5；OSWorld 2.0 为 Binary 19.4、Partial 52.3；HLE 为 35.9，脚注写 judged by GPT-4o。可比性标记都符合列规则：Pass rate 和 OSWorld Binary 记 comparable=false；OSWorld 没写完整题集还是离线子集，HLE 没写是否用工具和题集范围，所以这两条记 matchesPreferred=false。HLE 记为不用工具是推断，卡上没有明说。默认 effort 为 xhigh 有据可查，原文是 reasoning_effort="xhigh"  # xhigh by default。

benchmarks.facts: 维护方：Terminal-Bench 团队（页脚 "Hosted by Stanford / Harbor / Laude Institute"）。4.0 公告原文："We removed 8 tasks ... We fixed 19 tasks"，"All tasks in TB 4.0 are now set to a flat agent timeout of 8 hours"。TB 3.0 公告写的是 74 tasks，减去 8 题等于 66 题；榜首条目 n_trials=330，按每题 5 次试验算也是 66 题（66 题是推算结果，页面没有直接写出这个数）。主指标："Resolution rate"，即 accuracy 字段。各家用自己的 harness（Agent 列分别为 Claude Code、Codex 等）。榜单内嵌 JSON 的榜首是 Opus 5.5，配置为 Claude Code、reasoning_effort max："accuracy":64.85,"n_trials":330，日期 Sep 22, 2026。第二名 61.82，之后是两个 58.18。

维护方：Datacurve，论文为 arXiv 2607.07946。首页原文："tasks 113 repos 91 languages 5 models 28"，"Leaderboard v1.1 v1 ... 113 tasks · updated September 22, 2026"，"All models run on mini-swe-agent for consistency"。主指标 Pass@1。v1.1 榜首有三个并列 74%："gpt-6-astra [ xhigh ] 74 % ± 3 %"、gemini-3.8-flash [high] 74% ± 1%、claude-opus-5 [max] 74% ± 4%。榜上没有 Opus 5.5。页面同时提供 v1 切换，v1 是不可比口径。

维护方：Cognition（"FrontierCode Leaderboard By The Cognition Team"）。题量见原始博客："Diamond comprises the 50 hardest tasks, Main the 100 hardest (including Diamond), and Extended the full set of 150"。评分方式："Each model is run 5 times at every available reasoning effort ... average the metric across the 5 trials, then report each model's score at its best performing reasoning level"，所以官方榜报的是各模型的最佳档位，不一定是 max 档。1.1 版本于 07.07.26 发布，并弃用了 Diamond。榜单页内嵌的 schema.org ItemList "FrontierCode 1.1 Leaderboard (Main)" 原文：position 1 "Claude Opus 5.5" "Score 54.6%"，其后依次为 Claude Fable 5 53.5%、Claude Opus 5 53.4%、GPT-6 Astra 53.3%。changelog 最新一条是 Oct 7, 2026（Added Claude Haiku 5.5）。

维护方：Proximal，V2 博客发在 proximal.ai。frontierswe.com 原文："Scores across all 34 tasks. Each model runs 5 trials per task with a 20-hour budget"。主指标 mean@5（另可切换 worst→best@5），全部条目使用 proximus harness。榜首原文："1 GPT-6 Astra proximus 65.5 % ± 8.9 $1029.65 12.1h"；第二名 "Claude Opus 5.5 proximus 62.3 % ± 9.8"；第三名 Gemini 4 Argon 55.0%。当天默认视图里没有看到 Sonnet 5.5 和 Fable 5.1，它们可能在其他视图（Per provider / All）中。

维护方：XLANG Lab（香港大学），合作方包括 Snorkel AI、Simular 等，论文为 arXiv 2606.29537。首页原文："108 Long-horizon tasks 31 Self-hosted websites ... 27.25 Avg. scoring checkpoints"。论文以二元完成率为主指标（"our primary binary-completion metric at 500 steps"），partial score 是副指标。官方榜数据来自首页 leaderboard.js 加载的 official-results.json，其中 updatedAt 为 2026-10-05，datasetSize 108，releaseVersions 有 v2026.06.24、v2026.08.08、v2.1，datasetScope 分 full 和 offline。榜上能看到的最新模型是 Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol 这一代。full 集、官方 e2e 条目里 partial 最高的是 Claude Opus 5、max、batch tool、500 步、v2.1："binaryAccuracy": 44.33, "partialScore": 77.67"。agent 类条目 "Sai w/ Claude Opus 5" 为 partial 79.38、binary 41.67，official 字段为空。offline 子集上 Opus 5 max 的 partial 为 79.2。另有 monitor 榜 osworld-v2-monitor.xlang.ai/leaderboard，访问时返回 Cloudflare 1033 错误，未能打开。

维护方：Zapier，白皮书为 arXiv 2604.18934，GitHub 仓库为 zapier/AutomationBench。页面原文："47 real tools across six business functions"，"600+ Held-out evaluation tasks"；Fable 5.1 的脚注写了 "(260 of 657)"，说明私有集共 657 题。评分为确定性的终态检查（"No LLM-as-judge"），主指标为 Score。当前榜单版本 1.0.6，前几名原文："1 Gemini 4 Argon (High) 51.29% $1.70*"、"3 Claude Sonnet 5.5 (default fallbacks, Max) 44.75%"、"4 Claude Opus 5.5 (default fallbacks, Max) 42.47%"、"5 GPT 6 Astra (Max) 41.4%"。"default fallbacks" 的含义：模型拒答的任务改由厂商默认的回退模型重跑。

维护方：Toolathlon 团队，GitHub 仓库为 hkust-nlp/Toolathlon（HKUST NLP）。榜单页原文："108 # Tasks 32 (604) # MCP servers (# tools)"，"Toolathlon-Verified Current benchmark · Released June 30, 2026"。Verified 博客原文："Both versions contain the same 108 tasks"。主指标 Pass@1，另列 Pass@3 和 Pass^3。页头写着 "76.2% Best Pass@1 Score"，但表内最高一行是 "Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash (max) ✓ Open-Weights Default 2026-08-30 78.4 ± 1.9"，页头数字没有随表格更新。表里没有 GPT-6 或 Claude 5.5 代模型。页面下方另有旧版 Toolathlon 的存档快照（51 个模型），该快照不可比。

维护方：UC Berkeley RDI（"Led by Berkeley RDI and 300+ industry experts"），与 Snorkel AI 合作，Snorkel 上有镜像榜 https://snorkel.ai/leaderboard/agents-last-exam/ 。首页原文："55 sub-industries ... 1,500+ tasks collected toward a 5,000-task target"。官方榜通过 /api/demo/leaderboard 取数据，full split 共 152 题（splitTasks:152），默认按 passRate 排序。按 full split 计，Opus 5.5 原文："model":"claude-opus-5-5","harnessVariant":"thinking-max","tasks":150,"splitTasks":152,"passes":58,"passRate":0.38157...,"avgScore":0.63236...，即 Pass 38.2%、Score 63.2%。GPT-6 Astra codex reasoning-max 的 passRate 为 0.3421、avgScore 为 0.5926，即 34.2/59.3，与 OpenAI 公布的数字一致。Snorkel 页面列出两张表：第一张 "1 Claude Opus 5.5 Max Claude Code 38.2% 63.2%"，第二张（另一子集或视图）"34.3% 63.7%"。主指标是 Pass rate；我们要的 Score 是部分得分。

维护方：Center for AI Safety 与 Scale AI。lastexam.ai 原文："HLE has been finalized with 2,500 questions"，另有 "[09/22/2026] : HLE-Diamond is released" 和 HLE-Rolling 两个变体，两者都不可比。主指标 Accuracy（附 Calibration Error），评测不带工具。lastexam.ai 首页的表格停在旧模型（Gemini 3 Pro 38.3），并写明 "Also available at ... SEAL LLM Leaderboards"。Scale Labs 全集榜原文："1 GPT 6 Astra NEW 54.80 ± 1.94 Calib Err: 39 2 Fable 5.1 (xhigh) NEW 46.50 ± 2.00"。该榜上没有 Opus 5.5。Scale 另有 Text Only 版榜单，未打开。
主页和维护方同 HLE（CAIS 与 Scale AI，2,500 题）。官方渠道没有找到带工具（search/code）的排行榜：lastexam.ai 首页表格和 Scale Labs 的 humanitys_last_exam 榜都是不带工具的准确率。所以这一列只能依靠厂商自报的带工具数字，没有官方榜可供核对。

维护方：Stanford 研究者牵头，与 Terminal-Bench/Harbor 团队共同建设（"led by researchers at Stanford University and built by the team behind Terminal-Bench"）。原文："Our first release includes 70 tasks"，"Each evaluated model ran three independent trials per task across all 70 tasks"。主指标 Resolution rate。榜单链接会跳转到 hub.harborframework.com/datasets/terminal-bench-science/...?tab=leaderboard&leaderboard=v0-1-eval，数据由前端动态加载，curl 拿不到，所以实时榜数字未核实。发布博客的表格原文："Claude Opus 5 Claude Code 30.0% GPT-5.6 Sol Codex 22.4% Claude Fable 5 Claude Code 21.4%"。30.0 只是 8 月 27 日发布时的最高分，实时榜可能已有新模型。

维护方：SciCode 团队，作者主要来自 UIUC、Argonne 等机构（通讯作者 Minyang Tian、Eliu Huerta、Hao Peng）。原文："SciCode contains 338 subproblems decomposed from 80 challenging main problems"，题面可选附带科学背景说明（background）。官方榜列两项：Main Problem Resolve Rate 和 Subproblem。官方榜已严重过时，最新只到 o3-mini 一代。原文："OpenAI o3-mini-high 9.2 34.4"，即 Subproblem 34.4 为最高。榜单没有说明是否附带 background。

维护方：CritPt 作者团队（arXiv 2509.26574，50+ 位物理研究者，GitHub 和 HF 组织名为 CritPt-Benchmark）。官方评分服务器与 Artificial Analysis 合作运营，持续更新的榜单托管在 AA。arXiv 原文："CritPt consists of 71 composite research challenges ... decomposed to 190 simpler checkpoint tasks"。critpt.com 原文："We use average accuracy over 5 runs × 70 test challenges as our primary performance metric"，其静态表最高为 "GPT-5 (high, code & web)" accuracy "12.6%"，数字较旧。AA 页面原文："GPT-5.6 Sol (Max) scores the highest on CritPt with a score of 32.3%, followed by Claude Opus 5.5 (Max, Default Fallback) ... 31.7%"。AA 数字按规则不另记，只作为榜首参考。

维护方：Artificial Analysis，数据集来自 OpenAI GDPval（arXiv 2510.04374）。原文："GDPval-AA v2.1 uses 220 tasks developed by OpenAI ... 44 occupations and 9 major industries"，"Elo ratings derived from blind pairwise comparisons"，模型在 Stirrup agent 循环中带 shell 和浏览器运行。当前版本为 v2.1。榜首原文："Claude Opus 5.5 (Max, Default Fallback) scores the highest on GDPval-AA v2.1 with a score of 1866, followed by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Max, Default Fallback) ... 1838"。按 (1866−500)/2000×100 换算，归一化分为 68.3。

维护方：Surge AI，论文为 arXiv 2607.11192（作者 Suhaas Garre、Edwin Chen 等）。论文原文："the 100-item benchmark: the best model passes only 30.7% of the items"，并说明 "a graded rubric score as well as a strict task-level pass rate"。Surge 官方榜原文："1 GPT 6 Astra (Max reasoning) 34.2 % 1 GPT 5.6 Sol (Max reasoning) 30.7 % 1 Claude Opus 5.5 (Adaptive/Max) 30.6 %"。页面没有明确写出这个分数就是 all-pass，但 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 30.7 与论文的严格通过率一致，因此推断是严格通过率（all-pass）。AA 另有 GDP.pdf 榜，采用 5 次尝试的 all-pass 口径。

维护方：Artificial Analysis，HF 数据集为 ArtificialAnalysis/AA-LCR。原文："LCR features 100 questions across diverse document types"，当前版本为 AA-LCR v1.1，主指标为准确率。榜首原文："Kimi K3 (Max) scores the highest on AA-LCR v1.1 with a score of 88.7%, followed by Step 5 Preview with a score of 88.3% and MiMo-V2.6-Pro with a score of 86.3%"。
